title: Shinonome Ena — The Year Starts With 25:00〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Greeting each other like this really makes it feel New Yearsy, huh.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sure, but we're still just doing what we always do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Alright... Oh, before we do...
Are you okay to stay, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You have to get up early tomorrow, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If I don't get my usual work done, I feel like I won't be able to actually have fun tomorrow, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Right... In that case, thank you.
But don't feel compelled to push yourself too hard.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You're hanging out with Airi tomorrow, right? You mentioned something about buying lucky bags and stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, we're heading over to the mall over in the next town because it just got renovated.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <To celebrate their grand re-opening, they've decided to sell some pretty luxurious lucky bags.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You are? But you said you didn't want to come when I invited you the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. I really wanna go since Airi's also gonna be there, but the lucky bag I want is only being sold online!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<And they start taking orders at nine.
I can't take my eyes off my computer until then!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, can't you just order it on your phone?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, my internet connection at home is way more stable.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's not uncommon to just randomly lose your connection when you're outside, so I get it, but...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm done with those lyrics, K. I'll send them over now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, I wanna look at them too...
What you wrote might change what I draw!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. Looks like it's business as usual again for us this year.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And it's still early enough that I can get some actual sleep. So, I'll be going now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't cause Airi any trouble by oversleeping, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, yeah. Don't stay up too late, alright?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, that should be everything I need for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I know what I'm gonna wear, so it's time for bed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't cause Airi any trouble by oversleeping, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's no way I'm gonna oversleep when I get to spend an entire day with Airi.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I've set an alarm...
But I might give myself more snoozes than normal.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright...
Five times at fifteen minute intervals, and three at five right towards the end...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I won't have a choice but to wake up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, huh? It's already this late.
I need to get to sleep now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Don't worry. There's no way I'm gonna oversleep...)
